scope: getCatalog() filtered to data.length > 0 or personalBuild; stable 1-based indices 43–84 from catalog-baseline.json
method: Compared every catalog input with the original creator's current official installation page, repository README, or release. Verdicts describe catalog copy guidance, not runtime verification. MATCH means no material conflict found; UNCLEAR means the accessible creator instructions do not substantiate all catalog detail.

catalog.note: Own gds-0022.chd

inputs.evidence: Demo needs no retail data; full game uses creator's extraction tool and its Audio, FMV, DATA folders. Soundtrack download is mandatory only for music.

catalog.label: Extracted Tomb Raider game data
catalog.note: For the full game, run the official Beef Raider Extraction Tool on your owned Tomb Raider files, then drop its mod folder containing Audio, FMV and DATA. The demo needs no game data.

inputs.evidence: Creator describes Jedi Outcast assets0.pk3, assets1.pk3, assets2.pk3 and assets5.pk3 in JKXR/JK2/base and separately notes Jedi Academy support; the catalog's combined folder guidance does not name the exact files for each game. Demo can run without full assets.
inputs.correctedCopyText: For Jedi Outcast, supply assets0.pk3, assets1.pk3, assets2.pk3 and assets5.pk3 from GameData/base. Jedi Academy uses its own GameData/base assets. The Jedi Knight demo needs no retail data.

catalog.label: Owned Jedi Outcast or Jedi Academy game folder
catalog.note: Choose the original game folder, GameData folder, or base folder. VR4All checks the required PK3 files for the selected game.

inputs.evidence: Creator's Quest release and setup use owned Dark Forces data. Accessible release text did not establish the catalog's Remastered compatibility recommendation or that DARK.GOB alone is sufficient.

inputs.evidence: Creator requires hlvr and core, but current 1.0.85 also offers an optional in-app Steam download of the user's owned copy, so manual folder selection is no longer strictly mandatory.
inputs.correctedCopyText: To copy local Half-Life: Alyx data, choose the Steam game folder with hlvr/pak01_dir.vpk and core/pak01_dir.vpk; only hlvr and core need transfer. Qualyx 1.0.85 also offers an in-app Steam download of your owned game (creator says full-download acceptance testing remains).

catalog.label: Owned Half-Life: Alyx game folder
catalog.note: Choose the game folder from your Steam Half-Life: Alyx installation. It must contain hlvr/pak01_dir.vpk and core/pak01_dir.vpk. VR4ALL copies only hlvr and core; allow substantial headset space and transfer time. Use the extracted folder rather than a game archive larger than 8 GB.
